title: ResearchReport
description: Immutable pack of candidate evidence for a research brief. Not validated truth; not a proposal. See /artifacts/research-report.md.

brief_ref.description: Pointer back to the ResearchBrief this report answers.

question.description: The research question the brief posed.
examples: What are the current best practices for retry backoff in multi-agent pipelines?

evidence_items.description: Candidate evidence discovered within budget. Every item must carry resolvable provenance; never fabricated.

evidence_id.description: Stable identifier for this evidence item, referenced by downstream ValidationReport and Knowledge claim_provenance.

source_class.description: Category of origin, drives downstream policy/egress and rubric weighting.

excerpt.description: Short excerpt relevant to the research question.

provenance.description: Resolvable pointer to the evidence item's origin.

pointer.description: A resolvable locator (URL, repo path + commit, or other retrievable reference). Never fabricated.

signal_tier.description: Producer's own confidence label. Advisory only, not a validation verdict.

examples.title: exponential-backoff: reference implementation and rationale
examples.excerpt: Jittered exponential backoff avoids thundering-herd retries after transient failures.

coverage_gaps.description: Explicit statements of what the brief asked for that could not be answered given budget/policy/availability limits.
examples: No primary evidence found for retry behavior specific to gRPC streaming APIs within budget.

open_questions.description: Follow-up questions surfaced during research that the brief did not anticipate.
examples: Should retry ceilings differ between compute-bound and I/O-bound agent invocations?
